BETA Close X RS Group plc has announced the purchase of 185,023 ordinary shares for cancellation between August 24th and August 28th, 2026, as part of its £100 million share repurchase program. The weighted average price paid per share during this period was 744.05 pence. Following these transactions, the company's total issued ordinary shares will be 469,533,391, with no shares held in treasury, resulting in a total of 469,533,391 voting rights. Disclaimer* RS Group PLC 01 September 2026 RS Group plc 1 September 2026 Transaction in Own Shares RS Group plc (the "Company") announces that in the week 24 August 2026 to 28 August 2026, it purchased for cancellation the following number of its ordinary shares of 10 pence each (Ordinary Shares) through Barclays Bank plc, as part of its £100 million share repurchase programme announced on 20 May 2026 (the "Programme"). All Ordinary Shares were purchased from Barclays Bank plc as an "on exchange" transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange. Following the above purchases and cancellation of these Ordinary Shares, the Company will have 469,533,391 Ordinary Shares in issue, with no shares held in treasury. Therefore, the total number of voting rights in the Company is 469,533,391. This announcement is made in accordance with the requirements of UK Listing Rule 9.6.6.
